standard_prerequisites.name: The Postnikov system associated to a derived cartesian object
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 3062-3064: the objects X_n and the Postnikov system Y_n associated to K, with K = hocolim Y_n[n].

standard_prerequisites.name: Cartesian derived objects are g_{n!} of their components
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 3064-3066: X_n = g_{n!}K_n by cartesianity of K, so Y_0 = X_0 = g_{0!}K_0.

standard_prerequisites.name: The homotopy colimit triangle
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, \label{lemma-abelian-postnikov} (defining triangle of the hocolim)
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 3083-3090: the distinguished triangle with the direct sums defining the homotopy colimit, used for the final reduction.

core_obligations: Induction start (proof lines 3062-3068): the map K -> K' induces a compatible family Y_n[n] -> K'; by cartesianity X_n = g_{n!}K_n; since Y_0 = X_0, the vanishing of K_0 -> K'_0 implies Y_0 -> K' is zero.

The induction step (lines 3068-3082): from the distinguished triangle Y_n[n] -> Y_{n+1}[n+1] -> X_{n+1}[n+1] -> Y_n[n+1] one gets an exact sequence of Hom groups; the first group Hom(X_{n+1}[n+1], K') = Hom(K_{n+1}[n+1], K'_{n+1}) vanishes by assumption (2); hence vanishing passes from Y_n[n] to Y_{n+1}[n+1] and all maps Y_n[n] -> K' are zero.

The homotopy-colimit reduction (lines 3083-3100): from the defining triangle of the hocolim it suffices to show Hom((direct sum Y_n[n])[1], K') = product Hom(Y_n[n+1], K') is zero for all n; arguing as above this reduces to Hom(K_n[n+1], K'_n) = 0, which is assumption (3).
proof_roadmap: Start the induction at n = 0 using Y_0 = X_0 = g_{0!}K_0 and the vanishing of K_0 -> K'_0.
Propagate the vanishing through the Postnikov triangles using assumption (2).
Reduce the hocolim term to the component Hom groups and conclude with assumption (3).
difficulty_reason: Vanishing lemma (statement 3045-3056, proof 3058-3100): a map K -> K' out of a cartesian object inducing zero on K_0 is zero, proved by a Postnikov-system induction - the start uses the g_{n!} identification of cartesian objects (card L46169), the step uses assumption (2) on the distinguished triangles, and the hocolim reduction uses assumption (3); no verification is omitted. H2: derived-category induction with explicit vanishing hypotheses.
